mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", entity_id AS "entityId", resource_key AS "resourceKey", stage AS stage, initial_value AS "initialValue", max_value AS "maxValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.entity_resource_stage_values WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND entity_id = #{entityId} AND resource_key = #{resourceKey} AND stage = #{stage}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.entity_resource_stage_values (game_id, entity_id, resource_key, stage, initial_value, max_value, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{entityId}, #{resourceKey}, #{stage}, #{initialValue}, #{maxValue}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, entity_id, resource_key, stage) DO UPDATE SET initial_value = EXCLUDED.initial_value, max_value = EXCLUDED.max_value, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", entity_id AS "entityId", resource_key AS "resourceKey", stage AS stage, initial_value AS "initialValue", max_value AS "maxValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.entity_resource_stage_values WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, entity_id, resource_key, stage
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.entity_resource_stage_values_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, entity_id, resource_key, stage, initial_value, max_value ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, entity_id, resource_key, stage, initial_value, max_value FROM public.entity_resource_stage_values WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, entity_id, resource_key, stage, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, initial_value = EXCLUDED.initial_value, max_value = EXCLUDED.max_value
